title: Stellar Odyssey Lab
subject: Science
description: Explore the solar system and learn about STEM concepts through interactive exploration and AI-assisted feedback.
longDescription: Stellar Odyssey Lab is an AI-powered educational game where you play as an astronaut traveling through all 8 planets of the solar system, each one acting as a science teacher with a unique personality and a real STEM experiment to solve.

Instead of reading textbooks or answering multiple choice questions, you learn by having a live conversation with each planet by asking questions, unlocking hidden lab simulations, and forming your own scientific hypothesis.
It's designed to make concepts like escape velocity, the greenhouse effect, tidal forces, and thermodynamics feel like discoveries you made yourself, not facts you were told.
